title: MetaFund
tagline: A decentralized hedge fund potofocol enabling traders to create fund using different asset shares.
description: The core idea behind this project is to create a platform for experienced traders to monetise their trading skills by establishing a hedge fund, allowing other beginner traders or novice traders to benefit from their fund in return for a certain commission on the profits they generate. Our platform makes money from the fees collected from traders on each investment.
how_its_made: This project uses Avail Nexus Core Unified and Bridge for showing the user portfolio and allowing users to execute transactions from any chain they are using Nexus's BridgeAndExecute method. It also uses Pyth's price feed on-chain for trade settlements using the real-time price of different tokens. We are also using the Artificial SuperIntelligence Alliance U-Agent for analysing fund managers' wallet transactions to give risk and trust insight. We have used ChatGPT to provide skeleton code.
